description_en: Queries the number of requests for all paid domain names in your account
description_zh: 查询用户账号下所有付费域名的请求量列表
name: DescribeDomainStatisticsSummary

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number. The start value is 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100 and the minimum value is 1. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，最小值为1，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The start date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

You can query data from the last 90 days only. The value of `StartDate` must be greater than or equal to the current date minus 90 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

只能查询最近90天的记录，即：`StartDate >= Now - 90`
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en:
The end date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The default value is the current date
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

默认为查询当天的时间
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The search mode for the keyword. Valid values:

LIKE (default): Fuzzy match

EXACT: Exact match
parameters.help_zh:
关键词的搜索模式。取值：

模糊搜索（默认）：LIKE
精确搜索：EXACT
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en: The keyword. The search is performed in \`%KeyWord%\` mode and is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 关键词，按照“%KeyWord%”模式搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The threshold for the number of requests. This operation returns domain names whose request count is less than or equal to the specified value. For example, if you set this parameter to 100, domain names with 100 or fewer requests are returned. If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询总量阈值，也可查询相应请求量不大于threshold的数据。例如，如果您将该参数设置为100，可查询出请求量小于100次的域名。为空时查全部的域名
parameters.name: threshold

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
